De nuance die vergelijkingslijsten vaak: The nuance comparison lists often miss
Wat is het beste AI-model?: What is the best AI model?
Dat bestaat niet als universele keuze. E: There is no universal choice. A model may be stronger at complex coding but economically illogical for high-volume classification. The Model Guide optimizes for your task and constraints.
Waarom kijk je naar kosten per taak en n: Why look at cost per task rather than token price alone?
Een goedkoper model kan meer retries of: A cheaper model may need more retries or extra tokens. A more expensive model may finish in one run. The current calculator is a transparent token baseline; the Powerhouse loop can later calibrate it with real task outcomes.
Is een model met EU data residency autom: Does EU data residency automatically make a model GDPR-compliant?
Nee. AVG-compliance hangt ook af van doe: No. GDPR compliance also depends on purpose, legal basis, processor agreements, data minimization, security, subprocessors, retention and your specific implementation.
Waarom staan previewmodellen lager?: Why are preview models ranked lower?
Preview kan prima zijn voor experimenten: Preview can be fine for experiments, but lifecycle and stability risks matter in production. The ranking therefore applies a limited preview penalty.
Kan één workflow meerdere modellen gebru: Can one workflow use multiple models?
Ja. Vaak is routing economisch beter: ee: Yes. Routing is often more economical: a small model handles standard work, a stronger model handles difficult cases and a specialist model handles tasks such as OCR or reranking.
